content: Our approach draws inspiration from recent efforts that gamify collaborative training of machine learning agents over multiple rounds BIBREF19 and pit “builders” against “breakers” to learn better models BIBREF20. Recently, Dinan2019build showed that a similar approach can be used to make dialogue safety classifiers more robust. Here, we focus on natural language inference (NLI), arguably the most canonical task in NLU. We collected three rounds of data, and call our new dataset Adversarial NLI (ANLI).
